design: Snow CANINE QUADRUPED with short muscular body, broad muzzle, tiny ears, elaborate sideways flat moose antlers, mane of long cream muskox hair hanging from shoulders, four dark paws, SHORT tail. Low charging wolf gait and antler bite attack.

names.es: Chacal níveo de colas de cinta

design: Snow CANINE QUADRUPED, very tall narrow pointed ears, tiny slim long-legged jackal body, thin long muzzle, TWO long flat ribbonlike tails curling together, slate fur with cream throat, dark feet. Elegant four-legged bounds, biting attack. No antlers, no mane.

Snow heavy BIPED golem, tall narrow body formed of clear cyan ice slabs, huge circular upright ICE WHEEL halo integrated behind shoulders, head tiny diamond suspended in hollow chest, two massive triangular wedge forearms, two block feet. Slow two-leg heavy gait, overhead ice hammer attack. Wheel is solid anatomy not floating particles.

Snow heavy BIPED golem of twisted ancient dark roots armored by chunky ivory rime, broad forked stump head with two blue eyes, one huge asymmetrical root-club right arm and thin claw left arm, barrel chest, two short tree-trunk legs, frozen pale mushroom shelves on shoulders. Lumbering two-leg strides, club slam attack. Entirely different from crystalline golem.

Snow enormous FOUR-LEGGED BEAR with broad short bear muzzle, tiny ROUND ears, tiny nub tail, thick white bear fur legs and belly, gigantic single convex turtle-shell-like blue glacier armor dome over whole back with hexagonal plates, squat wide body. Clear four-leg bear running gait and front-paw slam attack. NO horns tusks long tails or wolf muzzle.

Snow CANINE QUADRUPED, broad hyenalike shoulders, short rounded ears, rust brown winter fur with cream dorsal crest, enormous pair of curved saber teeth extending DOWN from upper jaw, wide dark muzzle, four stout legs, long bare ratlike tail with white pompom tip. Low powerful canine running gait and saber bite. No antlers and no armor.

names.es: Lobo de ceniza de costillas de horno

design: Volcanic FOUR-LEGGED CANINE beast, very lean charcoal armored dog body, exposed huge copper rib-shaped external armor arches around orange sealed furnace chest, long narrow eyeless head with bright amber mouth, four long jointed legs, long single chainlike segmented tail. Black and copper materials with amber detail inside body only. Four-legged running and snapping bite. No smoke flames particles outside silhouette.

names.es: Murciélago de escarcha de orejas campana

design: Snow FLYING BAT, two huge drooping bell-shaped furry ears, small round cream bat body, tiny black nose, paired folded icy blue membrane wings shaped like scalloped fans with dark finger bones, very short tail and tiny hooked hind feet. Distinct fat rounded silhouette. Flight run-a upstroke run-b downstroke, diving claw attack, death crumpled folded bat on ground. All wings entirely inside cell.
